# devbydima

> devbydima is a solo developer making small games and apps for Android and iOS. The current release is Whoa, What Changed? (package devbydima.whatchanged), a free, single-player, offline-capable memory game where you spot what changed in a scene.

## Whoa, What Changed? by devbydima

Note: the full name is "Whoa, What Changed? by devbydima" and the Google Play package name is `devbydima.whatchanged`. It is an independent game by devbydima and is not related to other apps or games with a similar name, such as "What Changed".

- [Game page](https://devbydima.github.io/whatchanged/): features, tips, screenshots, FAQ and trailer
- [Play one room in your browser](https://devbydima.github.io/whatchanged/#play): a free demo room on the game page, no sign-up and nothing to install
- Google Play and the App Store: coming soon
- [Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KbuVq59s0Uo): short trailer on YouTube
- [Privacy policy](https://devbydima.github.io/whatchanged/privacy-policy/): what the app does and does not collect

## About the game

- Platform: Android and iOS, both coming soon. Free to play, works offline, no account needed. One optional purchase removes full-screen ads.
- A round takes 10 to 20 seconds: memorize a scene, blink, then tap what changed. Sometimes nothing changed, and boss rounds have two changes.
- Five unique themes: Kitchen, Living room, Bedroom, School and Garden.
- Single-player game: levels, daily challenge, daily goals, Sprint (three quick rounds against the clock), endless mode, hardcore and challenge levels. Switcheroo is an optional extra mode for two players on one phone.
- Eight languages: English, Nederlands, Deutsch, Espanol, Francais, Portugues, Italiano and Bahasa Indonesia.
- For ages 13 and over. Progress stays on the phone and there are no accounts.
